mission_05: Filter data to |running_variable - cutoff| <= bandwidth. Create treatment = (running_variable >= cutoff).astype(int).
For triangular kernel: weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - np.abs(running_variable - cutoff) / bandwidth). Use these as sample_weight in LinearRegression.

Fit separate regressions on each side of the cutoff: Y = α + β(X - cutoff) + τ·Treatment + ε. The coefficient τ is the treatment effect. For placebo tests, repeat estimation at cutoffs where no true discontinuity exists.
